name: labs/zhinst__zhinst-qcodes
title: Zurich Instruments PQSC trigger distributor (zhinst-qcodes)
intro: Zurich Instruments PQSC trigger distributor (zhinst-qcodes), adapted from zhinst/zhinst-qcodes. It reads `device_type`, `serial`, `firmware`, `streaming_nodes` and 1 more; runs `trigger` and `wait_done`. `trigger`: arm, run, stop or factory-reset the PQSC trigger generation. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
